_doc: side (M3 item 9): which way the blade crosses at the contact, -1 toward the lesser sim angle, +1 toward the greater, read in play from BattleFx.Grip's `grip cut` line (--clip); a clip with none alternates from the weapon's count. M3 interim: measured from today's clips by tools/anim/contact_measure.py (the blade tip's sweep crossing her facing, else its speed peak; frames from the clip's start at 60 fps, in clip time); A1's P4 pack replaces it. len (M3 MR 3): the clip's whole length in frames at fps (contact_measure.py prints `of N frames`: len = N - 1), and cancel (the frame a chain's cut stops limiting her): read only by a chained press record (skills.json press `chain`, Sim/SwingChain.cs); a beat not written falls back to the timing contract (cut 42 f, contact 14, cancel 22; heavy 54, 20, 30).
